text:
jamal: Quick heads-up: SRE leadership approved per-route SLO rebaseline and a controlled loadtest to validate new thresholds. Window: Tue 2026-04-07 01:00-03:00 UTC. This is a rehearsal for our new SLA guarantees. Please read runbook: https://go/runbooks/slo-rebaseline-loadtest (internal). :loud_sound:
maya: Summary: we will raise p99 SLOs for small-gen routes from 800ms->1000ms for a 30d probation, validate with loadtest, then roll out hard limits. No config changes to customers during test.
angelo: Ack. What traffic footprint for the loadtest?
jamal: Plan: staged ramp to 70% of prod RPS in west-1 only, 3 canary phases (5m ramp, 20m steady, 5m cool-down) repeated across 4 hours. Canary flags: internal-dev, beta, and control-prod-5pct.
ops-eng: We'll create temporary guardrails: circuit break at 1.5x baseline errors, auto-throttle if p99 > 1500ms for 10m. Rollback if 5xx > 1% sustained.
sre_oncall: Publishing status note: "Planned loadtest may cause transient latency increases to prediction endpoints. Monitoring active. No data loss expected."
deploy-bot: Loadtest scheduled: loadtest-slo-2026-04-07. Generator: locust-cluster-3. CI checks green.
liz: Partner-facing jobs run Tue morning; can we shift partner smoke to later that day?
jamal: Yes please move partner smoke to 06:00 UTC. @liz I'll follow up.
maya: Monitoring checklist: per-route p50/p95/p99, KV hit-rate, tail CPU on gpu-pools, queue depth. Alert channels: #oncall-pager and #sre-ops.
angelo: I'll own the canary dashboards and the rollback switch. Jamal, share dashboards link?
jamal: Link posted in runbook and pinned in this thread. Quick snippet for the load generator: ```bash
locust -f tests/load/generator.py --headless -u 2000 -r 200 --run-time 20m --host https://api-west-1.internal
```
ops-eng: We'll also enable quota constraints for control-prod-5pct to avoid unbounded cost.
sre_oncall: Rota updates done; escalation: on-call -> eng-manager -> SRE director.
maya: Communication plan: status page blurb during window and short post-mortem within 48h. Please ACK if you are unavailable during the window.
liz: Ack (will move partner smoke).
angelo: Ack. Oncall in channel.
jamal: Thanks all 44d I'll post a final reminder 24h before and live notes here during the run.
